name: Michalis Hadjipantela - § 25 - Am 13
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2027
part_text: *25.* Underlines the significant increase in carbon credit prices which at current emission levels would need an estimated EUR 950 000 for 2027;highlightsthat this cost reflects the ongoing surge in ETS prices, which are becoming unsurmountable for key sectors such as metallurgy and fertilizer production; remarks that the difficulties associated with decreasing Parliament’s emissions are insignificant compared to the expenses and other realities involved in reducing emissions in sectors with hard to abate emissions; calls, in the context of the ETS revision during the third quarter of 2026, for in depth impact assessments of the effect of ETS and its relevant phase-out targets on key sectors, as well as the adjustment of said targets in order to safeguard key national industries;
